title: Version 2.1.142 Release
description: Added new `claude agents` flags for configuring dispatched background sessions, fast mode now uses Opus 4.7 by default, plugins with root-level SKILL.md surfaced as skills, multiple bug fixes for MCP tool timeout, background sessions, daemon lifecycle, and various UI improvements.

title: Version 2.1.141 Release
description: Added terminalSequence field to hook JSON output, CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS env var, ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID for workload identity federation, claude agents --cwd flag, /feedback can now include recent sessions. Improved spinner feedback during long thinking periods. Fixed numerous bugs related to background side-queries, daemon status, agent type list, and permission modes.

title: Version 2.1.140 Release
description: Improved Agent tool subagent_type matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values, updated agent color palette. Fixed /goal hanging, settings hot-reload regression, claude --bg connection issues, remote managed settings retry logic, and Read tool validation with offset parameter.

title: Agent View and /goal Command (v2.1.139)
description: Added agent view (Research Preview) as a single list of every Claude Code session, /goal command to set completion conditions, /scroll-speed command, claude plugin details command, transcript view navigation improvements, hook args field for exec form spawning, MCP stdio servers now receive CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR. Fixed numerous bugs including deadlock with expired credentials, autoAllowBashIfSandboxed issues, and memory growth problems.

title: Background Agents in Slack
description: You can now launch Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread, understand context, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving the conversation. Includes search in settings, MCP progress notifications, dynamic tool registration, and roots support.

title: Cursor 1.0 - BugBot, Background Agent GA, and MCP One-Click Install
description: Cursor 1.0 release featuring BugBot for automatic code review, Background Agent general availability for all users, Agent support for Jupyter Notebooks (Sonnet models), Memories beta for conversation context, MCP one-click install with OAuth support, richer chat responses with Mermaid diagrams and Markdown tables, new Dashboard with usage analytics.

title: Simplified Pricing and Max Mode for All Models
description: Unified request-based pricing model, Max Mode now available for all state-of-the-art models with token-based pricing, new Tab model for multi-file suggestions, Background Agent preview with remote parallel execution, @folders support for entire codebase context, refreshed Inline Edit with full file edits and send-to-agent options, multi-root workspace support.

title: Rules Generation and Improved Agent Terminal
description: Generate rules directly from conversations with /Generate Cursor Rules command, auto-attached rules with path patterns, chat history moved to command palette, built-in diff view for reviewing agent code, images support in MCP servers, improved agent terminal control with editable commands, global ignore files, new models (Gemini 2.5 Pro/Flash, Grok 3/Mini, GPT-4.1, o3/o4-mini), project structure in context beta.

title: Team-level Copilot Usage Metrics via API
description: Team-level Copilot usage metrics now available via API, allowing enterprises to track and manage Copilot adoption across teams.

title: GitHub Copilot App Technical Preview
description: GitHub Copilot app is now available in technical preview, providing a new way to interact with Copilot features.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent Auto Model Selection
description: Copilot cloud agent now supports automatic model selection, optimizing the choice of model for each task.

title: Copilot CLI Agent and Unified Sessions in JetBrains
description: Introducing Copilot CLI agent and unified sessions view in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs, improving workflow integration.

title: Start Copilot Cloud Agent Tasks via REST API
description: Can now start Copilot cloud agent tasks via the REST API, enabling programmatic control and automation.

title: Copilot Memory Supports User Preferences
description: Copilot Memory now supports user preferences for Pro and Pro+ users, allowing personalized AI assistance.

title: Copilot Code Review Comment Experience Improvements
description: Improved Copilot code review comment experience with better UI and interaction patterns.

title: More Flexible Secrets and Variables for Copilot Cloud Agent
description: More flexible secrets and variables management for Copilot cloud agent, enhancing security and configuration options.

title: Rubber Duck in Copilot CLI Supports More Models
description: Rubber Duck feature in GitHub Copilot CLI now supports more models, expanding debugging and explanation capabilities.

title: Enterprise-Managed Plugins in Copilot CLI Public Preview
description: Enterprise-managed plugins in GitHub Copilot CLI are now in public preview, allowing organizations to manage CLI plugins at scale.

title: Devin Review & Quick Review (v2.2.17)
description: All Windsurf IDE users now have access to Devin Review and Quick Review with existing subscription. Devin Review available for self-serve users with 2 week free trial. Agent Command Center improvements with list display, improved sorting and filtering. Fixed Windows update bugs, MCP server issues, and improved Devin Local agent reliability.

title: Version 0.86.0 - GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Support
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite Preview, and OpenRouter Kimi K2 model. Improved /clear and /undo commands, model announcements display, and settings handling. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

title: March 2026 Release - No May Updates Found
description: Based on official release notes from Devin, the most recent updates documented are from March 2026. No specific May 2026 updates were found in the official release notes. Latest features include Devin Review API, Mermaid diagram rendering, per-PR auto-review toggle, sidebar session notifications, and MCP secret scoping.
